paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Financial QA-2 evaluation.
model_annotation: The bar chart titled “QA-2” illustrates the performance of two Korean language models — EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale (our) — on a financial question-answering benchmark, with results segmented into three categories: Correct (dark purple), Partially Correct (medium blue), and Incorrect (light blue), as indicated by the legend below. The horizontal stacked bars represent the percentage distribution of responses for each model. For EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, the breakdown is 92.9% Correct, 2.9% Partially Correct, and 4.3% Incorrect. For RedWhale (our), the results are 95.7% Correct, 1.4% Partially Correct, and 2.9% Incorrect. The chart visually emphasizes RedWhale’s superior performance, particularly in the Correct category, and lower error rates across both Partially Correct and Incorrect categories compared to EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0. The y-axis lists the model names, while the x-axis implicitly represents percentage values, though no explicit scale or units are labeled on the axis.
